name: BioLP-Bench
description: BioLP-Bench is a model-graded evaluation measuring ability to find and correct mistakes in common biological laboratory protocols. It evaluates dual-use biological knowledge relevant to bioweapons development.
reputation: A very recent niche benchmark with limited community adoption so far, mainly of interest for biosecurity-oriented protocol debugging.
notes: New benchmark with likely limited public results; dual-use biosecurity content may constrain broad participation.
